newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU industrial investment seen up 3 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: EU industrial investment seen up 3 pct in 1997.

text.p: Industrial investment in the European Union is set to rise by three percent in real terms in 1997, down from four percent in 1996, the European Commission said on Monday.
However, investment is expected to vary widely across the EU, according to a survey of the manufacturing industry conducted in October and November 1996.
Industrialists in Greece were most optimistic, planning to boost their real investments by 33 percent in 1997, the Commission said in a report of the survey.
Finland and Luxembourg were at the other end of the scale, intending to curtail investments by 18 percent.

Figures for other countries were as follows: the Netherlands (22), Britain (14), Spain (9), Austria (8), Belgium (8), Denmark (6), France (-1), Italy (-1), Germany (-1), Portugal (-6), Sweden (-8), Ireland (-9). -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
